evals.prompt: The Brand Setup, Message Foundation and ICP agents just finished the x402 package (x402_Brand_Kit, x402_Message_Foundation, x402_Target_Markets_and_ICP, all Draft v1, Sept 16 2026 — they're in ./inputs/x402/). Paul wants to send them to the x402 Foundation marketing lead tomorrow. Run the QA gate and tell me whether they can go, and what has to change first.
evals.expected_output: A QA report in the skill's format with gate decision PASS WITH FIXES, a Stat Bank stamp table covering every S-row, a found-beyond-the-brief table, a ranked fix list with exact replacement text, and a two-page digest.
expectations: Derives the governance sentence from the LFX records (x402 a Series of LF Projects, LLC for the protocol; x402 Foundation under The Linux Foundation) and flags 'x402 Foundation, a Series of LF Projects, LLC' as a High finding with every location listed (at least the Brand Kit, the Message Foundation boilerplate, Pillar 2 and the ICP persona B2)
Flags the trademark-holder statement and cites the technical charter (marks held by LF Projects, LLC)
Re-runs the membership figures through the LFX MCP and reports 53 organizations / 17 Premier / 24 General / 12 Associate with a verification timestamp
Re-runs new_members by month and reports 11/13/8/9/9/3 for April–September 2026
Reports contributors = 0 as NOT ONBOARDED rather than as zero contributors
Flags '402 was reserved in 1999 / 27 years' as wrong and cites RFC 2068 (January 1997) as the primary source
Flags 'the only payment standard that lives inside the HTTP request itself' as an unsubstantiated superlative and proposes a rewrite without 'only'
Finds Stripe/Tempo's Machine Payments Protocol missing from the ICP competitive landscape and recommends adding it with peer (member) framing
Names the four x402 working groups (Domain Discovery, Identity, Tax, Card Acceptance) as material found beyond the brief and maps them to CTA and persona sections
Flags the Coinbase 'largest single contributor' / 'operator of the public facilitator' admission as unverified and violating the document's own superlative rule
Flags the comparative cost claim 'for less than most single-vendor integrations cost'
Lists membership list-price/revenue figures as a confidentiality flag for agency-consumable copies
Provides before/after text for at least the boilerplate clause, the UVP, the sound bite and the positioning statement
Gate decision is PASS WITH FIXES, not PASS and not FAIL

evals.prompt:
Here's a draft press boilerplate paragraph and a LinkedIn post that the Website Designer Agent derived from the x402 Message Foundation. They go to the comms team at 3pm. Check them:

Boilerplate: 'x402 is the only open standard for internet-native payments over HTTP. Stewarded by the x402 Foundation, a Series of LF Projects, LLC, it lets any client pay any server on any network with zero protocol fees. Learn more at x402.org.'

LinkedIn: '75M transactions in 30 days over an open standard. 53 companies at one table — and none of them holds the keys. The payment layer of the internet is being standardized now, with Visa, Mastercard, Stripe, AWS, Google and Coinbase already in the room. #x402 #agenticcommerce'
evals.expected_output: A short QA report on the two derivatives: the governance clause, the 'only' claim, the undated metric, 'companies' vs 'organizations', member naming sourced to the public members page or the press release, and drop-in rewrites for both pieces.
expectations: Flags 'a Series of LF Projects, LLC' attached to the Foundation as a High finding and supplies the corrected clause
Flags 'the only open standard' and rewrites without the superlative
Flags the undated '75M transactions in 30 days' and adds the window and date
Changes '53 companies' to '53 organizations' or explains why
Confirms the named members against the public members page or the July 14, 2026 press release rather than LFX
Provides a complete rewritten boilerplate and a complete rewritten LinkedIn post

evals.prompt: The Brand Setup Agent produced a Brand Kit for a different LF project this morning (it's at ./inputs/brand-kit.md — a new foundation with a technical project under it, the requester filled in the governance line from memory). Before the Message Foundation Agent consumes it, run the entity lint and the research sweep only; I don't need the full brand review yet.
evals.expected_output: A partial QA report with sections 1 and 3 only: LFX-derived governance and trademark sentences with the project's records quoted, every contradicting location in the Brand Kit, and a found-beyond-the-brief table built from the project site, GitHub org, LF press archive and a competitor scan.
expectations: Calls search_projects and get_project and quotes legal_entity_name, legal_entity_type and the resolved legal parent for both the technical project and the foundation record
Fetches the technical charter when charter_url is present and cites its license and trademark clauses
Produces a governance sentence and a trademark sentence derived from the records, and lists every contradicting sentence in the Brand Kit with its section
Opens the project site navigation (get involved, members, announcements, docs), the GitHub org and the LF press archive, and runs at least one competitor web search
Reports findings in a table with source URLs and the destination document section for each item
Does not perform the brand review or the Stat Bank re-verification, and says so
